0.EN:
Oh, welcome!
...Wait, you're not a customer...

1.EN:
"Sorry... We suddenly started getting fewer customers too,
so we're trying to figure out why."

2.EN:
Ah, I see. Actually... I heard a rumor when I was outside
trying to pull in more customers.

3.EN:
Something happened at the shrine, apparently. I don't know what's
going on, but it's making people run away before I could even ask for details.

4.EN:
The ramen here looks sooo good,
but no one's here to try it... That's so sad...!

5.EN:
(Looks like the shrine holds the key to our problem.
We should check the shrine after we've asked around.)

6.EN:
Ahem! I hereby commence the strategy meeting
for the Supernatural Disaster Response Group!!

9.EN:
No need to hold back now! You all came through for us in our time of need!
You're nothing short of saints!

10.EN:
"This is all we can do at the moment,
but I hope it'll help you out."

11.EN: Wait here! I'll make you the best ramen you've ever tasted!

12.EN: Here you go! Chashu ramen, with extra chashu!

14.EN:
(The chashu is so thick and juicy!
The tonkotsu broth is incredibly rich,
and it pairs perfectly with the thin noodles!)

16.EN: All right then! Time to talk about busting that ghost!

17.EN:
I've tried everythin' I could think of,
but nothin' has worked so far...

18.EN:
To be an exorcist, one must be a holy believer...
Which means this is outside my field of expertise.

19.EN: "So we've never left square one, huh...?"

20.EN:
...I only... wanted...
......To get over... my regrets......

21.EN: "...Is exorcism really the right thing to do?"

23.EN:
"I think I might've heard the ghost's voice.
They said something about wanting to get over their regrets..."

24.EN: Really...?! We didn't hear anything, though?!

26.EN: "I-I didn't awaken to any powers, I don't think? Not like they do in manga, at least..."

28.EN: ...Familiar. Do you still have the proof of our pact?

30.EN: (I also had the pendant on me the time I first got paralyzed, right after I almost lost it...)

31.EN: Ack... That pendant... That power... Argh...

33.EN:
Fu... fufu... I see. So that's how it is.
The bloodstone had acted as a catalyst.
It must've manifested the spirit's will as a voice—what you heard was its lament!

35.EN: S-So... If we can use the pendant to talk to the ghost...

36.EN: Then we can ask them what their "regrets" are!

37.EN:
I didn't think of talkin' to them!
...Though that does sound kinda scary.

38.EN: All right then! Let's go to the shrine and—

39.EN: Wait. We must prepare ourselves first.

40.EN:
If we enhance the powers of the pendant,
we should be able to hear even more of the spirit's thoughts.

41.EN:
Follow me, my familiar.
We shall perform a summoning ritual!

42.EN: The ramen here was soooo good the last time we went!

43.EN:
Didn't we just eat curry, you ask?
Well, I'm still growing, so I can eat much more than you might think! ☆

44.EN:
Shouyu ramen is really the OG, but tsukemen is hard to beat...
Oh, but I really wanna try their champon too~!

48.EN: You shared the ramen and compared the different flavors...

50.EN:
Favna munches down on the wide variety of dim sum
and stuffs her mouth like a hamster.

51.EN: We're going to try our hand at a stall at the summer festival too!

52.EN:
But we just can't decide on what to put in our yakisoba...
Which do you prefer?

53.EN: Lots and lots of meat!:option1;All sorts of seafood!:option2

54.EN:
Walking around the festival sure is tiring, after all!
Let's stuff our customers full of energy!

55.EN: Aye aye, sir! I'll go talk to the fishmonger's!
